description: Corpus-driven ontology for Thevaram NER, entity linking, and knowledge graph construction.

entity_types.name: Deity
entity_types.definition: A worshipped divine person referred to by name.

entity_types.name: DivineManifestation
entity_types.definition: A named manifestation or form of a deity.

entity_types.name: DivineEpithet
entity_types.definition: A referring expression or poetic epithet that points to a deity or saint.

entity_types.name: MythologicalFigure
entity_types.definition: A mythological actor who is not normally the devotional target in this corpus.

entity_types.name: Saint
entity_types.definition: A saint, poet, or hagiographic exemplar.

entity_types.name: HistoricalPerson
entity_types.definition: A historical person such as a king or patron.

entity_types.name: ReligiousGroup
entity_types.definition: A religious community or devotee collective.

entity_types.name: SacredPlace
entity_types.definition: A temple site, shrine town, or sacred place addressed by a patikam.

entity_types.name: Region
entity_types.definition: A geographic or cultural region.

entity_types.name: MythicPlace
entity_types.definition: A mythic or cosmological location.

entity_types.name: River
entity_types.definition: A river or sacred watercourse.

entity_types.name: Mountain
entity_types.definition: A mountain or sacred hill.

entity_types.name: SacredObject
entity_types.definition: A narrowed class for ritual/iconographic artefacts and substances.

entity_types.name: Flora
entity_types.definition: A plant, flower, garland source, or sacred tree.

entity_types.name: Fauna
entity_types.definition: An animal or living creature.

entity_types.name: CelestialBody
entity_types.definition: A celestial body or visible heavenly object.

entity_types.name: DivineBodyPart
entity_types.definition: A narrowed iconographic body-part class, usually divine or mythological.

entity_types.name: MythologicalEvent
entity_types.definition: A canonical mythological event evoked by a span or epithet.

entity_types.name: TheologicalConcept
entity_types.definition: A narrowed Saiva theological or soteriological concept.

entity_types.name: CosmologicalConcept
entity_types.definition: A cosmological category or metaphysical structure.

entity_types.name: DevotionalAct
entity_types.definition: A devotional action such as worship, praise, bowing, or singing.

entity_types.name: Ritual
entity_types.definition: A ritual act, ritual complex, or ritual practice.

entity_types.name: Pan
entity_types.definition: A musical mode carried in patikam metadata or verse context.

entity_types.name: MusicalInstrument
entity_types.definition: A musical instrument.

entity_types.name: TextWork
entity_types.definition: A named or generic text/tradition/work concept.
